messages:
maya: noticed a small but consistent spike in day-boundary invoice deltas after the DST shift this weekend. digging in.
ajay: spike how big? total $ or token delta?
maya: about 0.14% token reassignments around the 00:00 UTC boundary for tenants in CET and EET. shows up as tokens moved to previous day in invoice-preview.
sam: interesting. our billing window logic uses tenant_timezone to truncate windows. DST happened in some regions this weekend and our timezone lib returned ambiguous local times for the midnight boundary.
leo: we saw similar ambiguity in sessionization last year. what code path calculates day buckets? is it in the ingest enrich or in the ledger transform?
maya: enrich attaches local_date via timezone convert in enricher v3 (lib tzconv v1.2). ledger trusts that local_date for invoice bucketing.
ajay: tzconv v1.2 had a DST patch in 2025 that changed ambiguous-time handling from 'fold=0' to 'fold=1' semantics. some tenants' configs used legacy fold setting pinned in staging. possible mismatch.
irene: ops ask: can we highlight affected tenants in invoice-preview and optionally hold billing until we reconcile? ops would like a hold toggle.
billing-eng: requirement: invoices for affected tenants must not be auto-closed until manual review; need a flag invoice_hold with reason=DST_AMBIGUITY. add to invoice-generator guard.
ops-bot: created dashboard card: https://console.internal.redwood/d/dst-buckets panels: ambiguous-count(3), token-shift-pct(7), affected-tenants(list). alert rule "dst-ambiguous-tokens" at 0.05% firing.
sam: proposed fix: compute billing window boundaries in UTC only and keep local_date as display-only. That avoids ambiguous local times entirely. downside: breaks current customer-facing 'billing period by local date' expectation.
ajay: alternative: keep local-date approach but use a deterministic fold policy: treat ambiguous hour as belonging to the later offset (fold=1) for billing. That matches how most customers expect midnight to behave after DST.
leo: whichever we choose, we need a migration strategy for historical previews. ops will need a one-time backfill that re-evaluates day-buckets for invoices in the DST week and recalculates any affected previews. backfill must be idempotent.
maya: for immediate mitigation I can deploy a patch to enricher to emit an extra header billing_epoch_utc (start_of_local_day_in_utc) so ledger can compute bucket purely from that field. Will that help?
ajay: yes if enrich emits billing_epoch_utc computed consistently using fold=1. ledger can prefer billing_epoch_utc if present; fallback to local_date if absent.
billing-eng: also need an audit column: orig_local_date, billing_epoch_utc, tz_lib_version so we can trace which lib produced the value.
irene: UX: invoice-preview should show a yellow banner for tenants with ambiguous-day events: "Potential DST boundary reassignments detected — review before finalizing invoice" with a link to run the DST re-eval job.
leo: runbook: (1) emit billing_epoch_utc on new events (2) run a backfill re-eval for last 7 days for tenants in CET/EET (3) set invoice_hold for tenants with >0.1% token shifts until review.
ops-bot: created runbook dst-re-eval-job and scheduled initial backfill for 01:30 UTC tomorrow.
sam: tests: create unit tests in tzconv to assert that ambiguous local times map to expected epoch with fold=1 for CET on DST day. add integration test that replays example events through enrich->ledger.
maya: I'll cut an enricher patch to v3.1 with billing_epoch_utc + tz_lib_version and roll as a canary to one partition.
ajay: beware: enrichment schema bump requires consumers to ignore unknown fields; ledger already tolerant. add schema migration note.
billing-eng: acceptance criteria: after backfill, preview vs ledger should align within 0.01% for the DST window. invoice_hold must prevent accidental statement closure.
irene: ops want a one-click "re-evaluate DST week" on the invoice-preview page that triggers the backfill for that tenant. small UX but helpful.
leo: logging: include original ingest kafka_offset and x-rw-request-id in the enriched payload so we can trace and rollback if necessary.
[00:30] ops-bot: enrichment patch job dst-enrich-v3.1 queued (job id job-12001).
[01:35] maya: canary deployed to partition 5. billing_epoch_utc present in messages. monitoring ingest -> ledger mapping.
[02:10] sam: initial backfill run on sample tenant t-222 shows 18 tokens moved from 2026-03-28 to 2026-03-27 local day after re-eval. preview updated accordingly.
billing-eng: good. mark t-222 as reviewed and clear invoice_hold.
ajay: follow-up: prepare migration plan doc and a DB migration to add billing_epoch_utc index so backfills are fast.
maya: creating ENG-PLAT-DB ticket for index and backfill orchestration.
irene: thanks all. ops: once backfill stabilizes, update the UI to show re-eval button and remove temporary alerts.
[04:00] ops-bot: job job-12001 completed: canary succeeded; scheduled full rollout later today after index created.
